title: Advanced stroke styles: dashed, dotted, ragged, hatched
description: Extend the Flash 8 stroke rendering in packages/core/src/engine/renderer.ts to support all stroke styles: Solid (done), Dashed, Dotted, Ragged, Stippled, Hatched. Add StrokeStyle type to engine/types.ts stroke interfaces. Implement using Canvas 2D setLineDash + custom path rendering for ragged/stippled/hatched. Purely packages/core/src/engine/ — no UI changes. See docs/03-drawing-vector-graphics.md and docs/05-color-strokes-fills.md.
